name: common
description: Shared mindset skills required by the alegomes topology plugins. Ships mental-model, active-listener, zero-micromanagement, conversational-response, till-done, autonomous-mode, green-or-revert, and acceptance-completeness. Agents: completion-auditor (independent last-mile acceptance gate). Commands: /doctor (valida a instalação do harness — plugins, hooks, baseline, worktrees, handoffs), /metrics (telemetria do próprio harness: sessões, builds, bloqueios de gate, vereditos de prova — ledger em ~/.claude/cepa-telemetry alimentado pelos hooks via _telemetry.py), /autonomous-start, /autonomous-resume, /debrief, /recap, /handoff (save a rich session handoff for seamless resume), /branch, /return, and the per-session worktree lifecycle (/worktree-start, /worktree-merge, /worktree-list, /worktree-discard, /worktree-name, /worktree-label — get/set a durable free-text purpose stored as the branch description) for parallel `claude` windows on one repo, plus /wrap-up — the one-shot session-shutdown chain (commit → handoff → merge into the integration branch → push → prune, behind a single confirmation; --discard for dead ends) that reuses worktree-merge's green-gate / single-owner / conflict-stop guards. Launcher: bin/ccw — drop-in for `claude` that auto-isolates a session into its own git worktree only when another live session already occupies the tree; `ccw -s <name>` forces/resumes a named worktree, and `ccw -s` with no name opens an interactive picker (fzf, else a numbered menu) of recent session/* worktrees — terminal-agnostic, unlike Tab completion which Warp's own engine ignores. Completions: completions/_ccw — zsh tab-completion for `ccw -s <slice>`, offering existing session/* worktrees newest-first, each captioned with its label (works in standard terminals; Warp ignores zsh completions, so use the `ccw -s` picker there). Hooks: autonomous-checkpoint (PostToolUse on Task), session-log (UserPromptSubmit), session-subject (UserPromptSubmit — lexical subject-shift detection + wrap-up/handoff nudge; points at /common:wrap-up when the session is landable, else /common:handoff), session-activity (PostToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit — records touched dirs), session-registry (SessionStart/SessionEnd — live-session registry, overlap warning, worktree auto-clean + unmerged reminder, WIP-autosave, transparent handoff resume, deferred worktree prune-on-exit so /wrap-up never deletes its own live cwd), session-checkpoint (Stop — continuous mechanical handoff skeleton at .claude/handoffs/<branch>.md, crash-proof), mark-build-stale + capture-build-result + gate-advance (the green-or-revert state machine), enforcement-guard (PreToolUse Bash + Edit/Write/MultiEdit — blocks subagents from writing the plugin/hook/settings enforcement surface), lead-no-worktree (PreToolUse on Task — blocks worktree-isolated leads), acceptance-gate (PreToolUse on transitionJiraIssue — blocks In-Review while the acceptance audit is incomplete). Helpers: _wtlib.py + session-launch.py + session-worktrees.py (worktree engine), _handoff.py (handoff file format + zone-preserving IO), expertise-append.py (flock-serialized append+prune for the shared mental-model.yaml files).
